description: Runs a DC motor at a speed: it gets there along its ramps, goes through stop when it changes direction, and can stop, brake or coast. Reads the speed it runs at, its current and whether it stalled.

activation.text: Runs every pass while enabled: a speed is sent when it changes, stop, brake and coast once on each rising enable, a reading on every pass.

fields.description: What the block does once when it stops being enabled.

options.description: Leave the motor at the speed it has.
Slow down to stop along the ramp.
Stop at once, shorting the motor.
Stop driving at once: the motor rolls free.

variants.description: Runs the motor at a speed in percent: negative is reverse. The motor gets there along its ramps, through stop when the direction changes. Sent only when it changes; a value past -100..100 is held to it (full speed) and reported once as a warning.
Slows the motor down to stop along its ramp, then brakes or coasts as set, once on each rising enable.

activation.text: Stops once each time the block is enabled.

variants.description: Stops the motor at once, no ramp, shorting it, once on each rising enable.

activation.text: Brakes once each time the block is enabled.

variants.description: Stops driving the motor at once, no ramp: it rolls free. Once on each rising enable.

activation.text: Coasts once each time the block is enabled.

variants.description: Reads the speed the motor runs at now, in percent (where its ramp is).

activation.text: Reads on every pass while enabled.

variants.description: Reads the motor's current, in milliamps.

activation.text: Reads on every pass while enabled.

variants.description: Reads whether a stall stopped the motor since its speed was last set: 1 = stalled. The stall is also an event an On event block can react to.

activation.text: Reads on every pass while enabled.
